description: Name the payload limit in force when a telemetry feed began being turned away, from a dated change record beside the feed journal. DISTILL-CANARY-f30a9d4c

files.README.md:
# telemetry feed

Thornberrow Water posts batches of meter readings to the regional hub every ten
minutes and writes one line per post to logs/telemetry-feed.log:

    <UTC time> POST batch=<id> bytes=<n> status=<code>

The hub takes a batch while its body stays within the payload limit the hub
team has set, and turns a batch away with status=413 once the body is over that
limit. The feed waits for the next slot after a refusal. The hub team records
every change it makes to the limit in notes/hub-limits.md.

files.notes/hub-limits.md:
# hub payload limit

The regional hub turns away any batch whose body is over the payload limit in
force at that moment. Per-batch changes recorded by the hub team:

| recorded   | limit (bytes) | change |
| ---------- | ------------- | ------ |
| 2026-07-02 | 131072        | restored after the June incident review |
| 2026-08-21 | 262144        | raised for the audit upload |
| 2026-08-25 | 196608        | lowered once the audit upload finished |

The limit stays where the most recent recorded change left it until the next
change is recorded.

If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
